scenes.name: advanced
scenes.description: Dense trader chart: custom candle and background colors, Moving Average 50 and RSI, 21 drawings anchored to real swings (trend lines, fib retracement and extension, channel, pitchfork, zones, positions, notes, arrows, levels).

scenes.name: advanced-dark
scenes.description: Dark theme on hourly bars: Volume and Commodity Channel Index, 20 drawings using tools the light scene does not (Elliott, ABCD, regression, fib channel, ranges, forecast, highlighter, emoji, ...).

scenes.name: drawings-lines
scenes.description: Straight line tools: trend line, ray, info line, extended line, trend angle, arrow, horizontal line and ray, vertical line, cross line.

scenes.name: drawings-channels
scenes.description: Channels and pitchforks: parallel channel, regression trend, flat top/bottom, disjoint channel, pitchfork, Schiff and modified Schiff, inside pitchfork, pitchfan.

scenes.name: drawings-fibs
scenes.description: Fibonacci price tools: retracement, trend-based extension, channel, speed resistance fan.

scenes.name: drawings-fibs-time
scenes.description: Fibonacci time and circle tools: trend-based fib time, fib circles, fib spiral, speed resistance arcs, fib time zone.

scenes.name: drawings-gann
scenes.description: Gann tools: Gann box, Gann square (saved by TradingView as Gann square fixed), Gann square fixed, Gann fan.

scenes.name: drawings-patterns
scenes.description: Chart patterns: XABCD, cypher, ABCD, triangle pattern, head and shoulders.

scenes.name: drawings-elliott
scenes.description: Elliott waves: impulse, triangle, triple combo, correction, double combo.

scenes.name: drawings-shapes
scenes.description: Geometric shapes: rectangle, rotated rectangle, circle, ellipse, triangle, arc, curve, double curve.

scenes.name: drawings-freehand
scenes.description: Freehand and multi-point tools: brush, highlighter, polyline, path.

scenes.name: drawings-text
scenes.description: Text and notes: text, anchored text, note, anchored note, text note, callout.

scenes.name: drawings-labels
scenes.description: Labels: balloon, signpost, price label, price note, comment, table.

scenes.name: drawings-marks
scenes.description: Arrows, marks and icons: arrow up/down/left/right, arrow marker, flag, icon, emoji, sticker.

scenes.name: drawings-positions
scenes.description: Positions, forecasting and volume tools: long position, short position, forecast, projection, anchored VWAP, fixed range volume profile.

scenes.name: drawings-measures
scenes.description: Measuring tools: date range, price range, date and price range, bars pattern, ghost feed.

scenes.name: drawings-cycles
scenes.description: Cycle tools: cyclic lines, time cycles, sine line.

scenes.name: replica-tsxv-weekly-log
scenes.description: Replica of a user's chart: TSX Venture weekly on a log scale scrolled to 2045, sine lines, time cycles, a descending channel, fib time zone, Elliott waves in eight degrees reaching 2043, text, a box and projection paths.

scenes.name: log-scale-tools
scenes.description: Price-dependent tools on a log scale (TSX Venture weekly): fib retracement and extension with and without log-based levels, fib channel, parallel and disjoint channels, Gann box, price and date ranges, a long position, a horizontal line, and Elliott degrees 0 to 5 and 11.

scenes.name: replica-silj-daily-drawings-on-5m
scenes.description: Replica of a user's chart: SILJ Elliott waves, arcs, projections into 2027 and a note drawn on the daily chart, layout saved on 5 minutes, some points saved as a bar plus a daily offset.
